source: docs/tools.json (AI assistant descriptors only; the Studio API OpenAPI owns every other tool)

tools.name: undo_last_ai_action
tools.title: Undo latest Mozart action
tools.description: Undo the latest still-applied AI DAW action in the project.

tools.name: mozart_ai_command
tools.title: Mozart AI command
tools.description: Give Mozart AI a natural-language instruction for an owned project, exactly like typing it in the Studio assistant bar: mixing ('less reverb on the lead'), transport, tempo, clips, patterns/instruments, sound search, composing. Mozart plans validated engine actions, executes them, records undo, and replies. If it answers with a clarification, respond to it with a new command. Destructive steps are refused until the user confirms; then pass confirm_destructive=true. Asked to make a new song/beat/track, Mozart answers with modelChoice (which model makes it); call again with the same command and generator set to an available option id ('mozart' = editable MIDI in the DAW; the others render audio onto a new lane and can take minutes).

project_id.description: A project id returned by list_projects / create_project. Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

track_id.description: A take/clip id from list_tracks or get_project (or a lane id). Optional: defaults to the project's first vocal take. Constraints: max length 64

generator.description: Constraints: one of ace_step, elevenlabs_music, lyria, mozart, stable_audio_25, yue2

tools.name: mozart_ai_chat_history
tools.title: Mozart AI chat history
tools.description: Read the project's shared Mozart AI thread (prompts and replies from every collaborator), newest page first; use before=<seq> to page older messages.

project_id.description: A project id returned by list_projects / create_project. Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

tools.name: get_mozart_ai_job
tools.title: Get Mozart AI job status
tools.description: Progress and result of a background Mozart AI command (an audio-model generation started by mozart_ai_command with a generator): status queued | running | done | failed | cancelled | timeout, the current step, and the new lane/clip when done.

project_id.description: A project id returned by list_projects / create_project. Constraints: min length 1; max length 64
